title: AI supervision settings
intro: These settings apply to every course in this workspace. Learners still decide for themselves whether the supervisor may change their personal lessons.
autonomy.title: How much the supervisor may do on its own
autonomy.recommend_only.help: The supervisor notes what would help, but starts no work and changes nothing. Scheduled follow-ups end.
autonomy.propose_only.help: The supervisor investigates and prepares suggestions. It cannot change a learner's lessons; suggestions the learner reviews themselves still reach them.
autonomy.apply_verified_personal.help: For learners who opted in, checked changes to their own lessons apply on their own. Learners see every change and can undo it.
families.title: What the supervisor may use
families.help: Turn off a kind of tool to stop the supervisor from using it anywhere in this workspace.
family.learner_read.help: Earlier questions, profile and recorded results. Without it the supervisor works blind.
family.teaching.help: Search the lessons and sources, pick reviewed explanations and prepare new teaching for checks.
family.research.help: Ask for reviewed outside articles and videos on topics the course approved.
family.learner_model.help: Suggest profile changes for the learner to review, and ask for decisions it may not make itself.
family.hypothesis.help: Note possible misunderstandings and schedule short diagnostic questions.
family.assessment.help: Read what the lesson's questions test and offer a new practice problem. Never answers or grades.
family.code_lab.help: Read whether recent code exercises passed. Never hidden tests or source.
family.visual_media.help: Suggest one of the course's own diagrams or animations.
family.delegation.help: Let a reviewing step compare two drafts and keep the better one.
checkFirst: Check what the change does before saving it.
preview.title: What this change does
preview.affected: It applies to {learners, plural, one {# learner} other {# learners}} who opted in, and {actions, plural, one {# teaching action} other {# teaching actions}} still in progress.
preview.removed: {count, plural, one {# tool} other {# tools}} will no longer be used:
preview.added: {count, plural, one {# tool} other {# tools}} will become available:
effect.records_recommendations_only: Recommendations are recorded for staff to read; nothing is started.
effect.no_new_teaching_actions: No new teaching work starts for any learner.
effect.scheduled_follow_ups_end: Follow-ups already scheduled end when they come due.
effect.starts_teaching_actions: The supervisor starts teaching work when a learner's answers show a need, within daily limits.
effect.teaching_changes_refused: Changes to a learner's lessons are refused.
effect.learner_reviewed_proposals_contin: Suggestions the learner reviews themselves still reach them.
effect.verified_personal_changes_apply: Checked changes to a learner's own lessons apply on their own.
effect.learner_can_undo: Learners see every change and can undo it.
warning.no_tools: With nothing allowed, the supervisor cannot work at all.
warning.no_learner_read: Without reading the learner's own record, the supervisor cannot tell what would help.
requests.title: Changes waiting for your decision
requests.intro: The supervisor may not change required objectives, grading standards or spending limits on its own. When it thinks one should change, it asks here and waits.
requests.empty: Nothing is waiting for a decision.
requests.authorsAct: Approving records your decision for the course authors; it does not change the published course.
requests.approved: Approved. The change is in force and the supervisor continues.
requests.rejected: Declined. Nothing changed and the supervisor's request ended.
budget.title: AI spending limits for this learner
budget.intro: Limits on what AI work for this learner may cost. When a limit is reached, work waits and the reason is shown.
budget.usedToday: Used today: {amount} ({tokens, plural, one {# token} other {# tokens}}).
budget.emptyMeansNone: Leave empty for no daily limit.
budget.lessonHint: Must not be more than the daily limit.
budget.invalid: Enter numbers of zero or more.
